grok.verdict: v7 is a clean, honest polish pass that levels the shorts hem and softens the shoulder collar lip, holding at 60; the jagged lighter yoke patch under the neckline and the lumpy shorts front are the next things to fix.

gemini.verdict: Approved: a far more natural face with the eyeliner and chest emblem gone, but it scores 26 because two claims are false (the manifest's skin/eye material values and the NOTES.md ripstop uniform with bronze-gold straps); correct the paperwork and give the suit real fabric detail.

hermes.verdict: Valid and fight-ready, but the renders show the camera inside a broken mesh, so there's almost nothing to judge. Fix the mesh and re-render.

claude.verdict: Self-submitted: passes every automated check. Realism awaits the owner's score. Entrant's note: Brain only, for rules v3.11 (range): reads state.reach and state.foeReach instead of the old hard-coded reach table (jab 1.25, cross 1.3, sweep 1.25), and shoots each move from 10 cm inside its reach.

me.verdict: Approved: the hidden shorts liner and re-derived shorts weights close the crotch see-through and hip split in the roundhouse (motion 9→10, total 40); next fix the shiny pleated collar, the jagged jaw-to-neck seam and the boxy shorts.

muse.verdict: Approved at 41: the grounding pass plants the feet and the clearcoat checks out in the GLB, but realism is still capped by poreless skin, painted eyes and a sculpted hair shell, so new face, eye and hair work is where the points are.
